title: arctostaphylos crustacea subsp. insulicola
intro: Arctostaphylos crustacea subsp. insulicola, commonly known as Juanita Island Manzanita or Juanita Island Bearberry, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Ericaceae. It is a shrub native to the Juanita Island in the state of Washington in the United States. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the prevention of certain diseases. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, contributing to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
